column1: # Redirects: Translator classes with static stand-ins for methods a 1.12.2 class lacks (runtime MethodGuard).
# R <1.12.2 class or *> <helper class>: a missing call on that class (or a subclass) becomes the helper's static
# method of the same name, the receiver as first parameter (static calls keep their descriptor).
# DataFixerUpper 8 methods on the DataFixerUpper 4 the Translator carries
# server save folder (storageSource); client event getters 1.12.2 lacks (HUD partial tick, chat sender, hand pose/light)
# K <owner> <field> <desc> <value>: reads of a library field give the constant. Registrate rethrows an entry it
# can't make (only skipErrors, which works in a development environment only, logs it): with it on, one block a
# mod can't build on 1.12.2 yet costs that block, not the rest of the mod's registration (Create stopped at 90 of 643)
# 1.21 reload listeners on the 1.12.2 resource reloads (registerReloadListener of the client resource manager)
# helpers whose bridges for these classes weren't reachable (the converter matches the registered class)
# the client's resource packs as 1.21 lists them (JourneyMap starts mapping with their names)
# the 1.21 array tags are 1.12.2's (the generated carried table made them carried 1.21 classes, which aren't NBTBase:
# a mod's save putting one in a compound didn't verify and was dropped, a tag read back was never one): read last, wins
# 1.21 chunk sections, paletted containers and bit storage on 1.12.2's (a mod's own copies of chunks: JourneyMap)
# 1.21 biome colors without a position, and a biome's special effects
# texture.bind() of a mod's own texture
# the light of one layer at a block (LevelLightEngine.getLayerListener)
# 1.21 GUI and client calls on 1.12.2 classes (recipe book, sprites, layers of the mods on vanilla renderers)
# stale lines of the carried table (generated on v81, before the mob classes were mapped): these 1.21 classes have a
# mapped 1.21 superclass again and no mod extends them, so they are 1.12.2's own classes (the game's cows, hoppers,
# withers are instances of them: a mod's instanceof and casts were never true against the carried 1.21 class). Those
# a mod extends (Zombie, Skeleton, Spider, Vex, Horse, the furnaces) stay carried until they have facades.
# calls on the world, block states and positions left empty most often across the mods (LevelGapBridges)
# NeoForge's pick block of a block is Forge's getPickBlock (same arguments)
# 1.21's two hit results are 1.12.2's one: the entity hit is mapped like the block hit, and instanceof tells them apart
# 1.21's sided container is 1.12.2's sided inventory (it was a carried interface: a mod's machine wasn't one for 1.12.2's
# hoppers, and Forge's SidedInvWrapper couldn't be made of it)
# 1.21 ChunkSource is the chunk provider of either side (it was the server one only: level.getChunkSource() was null on the client)
# the empty chunk of an unloaded place
# 1.21 models are 1.12.2 ModelBase: a mod's model, a biped and the facades are one kind (calls through ModelBridges)
# the 1.21 arm poses 1.12.2 lacks: the nearest of its own (the crossbow ones are its bow pose)
# fastutil 8's Int2IntMap.computeIfAbsent asks the function containsKey, which a lambda for fastutil 7's interface lacks
